title: SkillCapturedData
description: data of skill.captured (registry 1.4.0, ADR-0034, FR-SKL-01): one step was added to a taught skill's captured list. Written once per step, after the record write commits, so the list grows only as steps are recorded (HR-1). The envelope follows TS-11: the actor's Desk world, actor and target that person, district, level and item null, vis [] and authz null. credits and trace name the skill_capture role when a model read the recording, upload or description. No step text, file name or media here: the artifact is a pinned id and version.
